findings.reason: without naming a warm `measure --arm` run per §0 arm, node (e) can complete and close clause (1) with no evidence of the 60 s or 64 GB bound, and a violation of the plan's whole point would go unreported.
findings.text: node (e) closes clause (1) on "one H200 lane run then shows the four point-program rows served as hits with NOVA_CACHE_MISS_BUDGET at zero", but clause (1) at plan.html:68 bounds the first call at "at most 60 s, with at most 64 GB peak host memory"; those two numbers are recorded only by the per-arm `measure` receipt (`scripts/prototypes/cached_point_remeasure/measure.py` writes `first_call_seconds` and `first_call_peak_rss_bytes`), and the pre-warm's own `measure --arm` rows run cold because filling the cache is what the pre-warm is for, while `scripts/h200_test_lane/run.sh` is `--mode pytest` over tests and records hit/miss counts, not per-arm first-call seconds or peak memory — so the section's binding bound passes with nothing measuring it

findings.reason: a worker measuring against the cited 1e-9 would accept a form that moves derivative bits by 1e-10, which clause (2) forbids, and node (c)'s own negative result (2.0e-4) is recorded against the wrong standard, so the identity gate the section rests on is stated at the wrong strictness.
findings.text: the node (c) text and the section paragraph at plan.html:65 both say clause (2) is "bit-identical ... and derivative entries within 1e-9 relative" / "outside the 1e-9 of clause (2)", while clause (2) at plan.html:68 requires the cached program's rows to be "bit-identical, values and every derivative entry" to the cold-compile rows in the same job; the cited tolerance is looser than the clause and belongs to no current clause at all

findings.reason: a coordinator composing a brief from the stated aim would commission compile-shrinking work that the lead's 2026-11-18 ruling ends, which is exactly what node (e) is not to do.
findings.text: the opening paragraph still sets the section's aim as "Bound that program with the lever §5's compile attribution names" and calls it "The section's aim is unchanged", while the same section at plan.html:65 records "no node of this section shrinks the cold compile any further, and no cold-compile bound remains to be met" and §3 still carries status `implementable`; two of the levers it names are recorded as retired or not pursued
